title: Three-arm ANOVA F
context: Compare all three treatment arms at once.
task: Set result to the F-statistic of a one-way ANOVA of score across the three arms (Placebo, DrugA, DrugB), rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
g = [trials.loc[trials['arm'] == a, 'score'] for a in ['Placebo', 'DrugA', 'DrugB']]
result = round(float(stats.f_oneway(*g).statistic), 3)

title: ANOVA p-value
task: Set result to the p-value of the one-way ANOVA across the three arms, rounded to 6 decimals.
answer:
g = [trials.loc[trials['arm'] == a, 'score'] for a in ['Placebo', 'DrugA', 'DrugB']]
result = round(float(stats.f_oneway(*g).pvalue), 6)

title: ANOVA decision
context: Reject the null of equal means?
task: Set result to 'Reject H0' if the ANOVA p-value < 0.05 else 'Fail to reject'.
answer:
g = [trials.loc[trials['arm'] == a, 'score'] for a in ['Placebo', 'DrugA', 'DrugB']]
p = stats.f_oneway(*g).pvalue
result = 'Reject H0' if p < 0.05 else 'Fail to reject'

title: DrugB vs Placebo
task: Set result to the two-sided p-value of an independent t-test (equal var) of DrugB vs Placebo scores, rounded to 5 decimals.
answer:
b = trials.loc[trials['arm'] == 'DrugB', 'score']
p = trials.loc[trials['arm'] == 'Placebo', 'score']
result = round(float(stats.ttest_ind(b, p).pvalue), 5)

title: DrugA vs Placebo
task: Set result to the two-sided p-value of DrugA vs Placebo (equal var), rounded to 5 decimals.
answer:
a = trials.loc[trials['arm'] == 'DrugA', 'score']

title: Cohen's d DrugB vs Placebo
task: Set result to Cohen's d = (mean DrugB − mean Placebo)/pooled std (ddof=1 pooled), rounded to 3 decimals.
answer:
b = trials.loc[trials['arm'] == 'DrugB', 'score']
p = trials.loc[trials['arm'] == 'Placebo', 'score']
nb, np_ = len(b), len(p)
sp = np.sqrt(((nb - 1) * b.var() + (np_ - 1) * p.var()) / (nb + np_ - 2))
result = round(float((b.mean() - p.mean()) / sp), 3)

title: 95% CI for DrugB mean
task: Set result to the lower bound of the 95% t-CI for the mean DrugB score, rounded to 2 decimals.
answer:
b = trials.loc[trials['arm'] == 'DrugB', 'score']
n = len(b)
ci = stats.t.interval(0.95, n - 1, loc=b.mean(), scale=b.std() / np.sqrt(n))
result = round(float(ci[0]), 2)

title: A/B difference in rate
task: Set result to the difference in overall conversion rate (treatment − control) as a percentage, rounded to 2 decimals.
answer:
c = ab_daily[ab_daily['variant'] == 'control']
t = ab_daily[ab_daily['variant'] == 'treatment']
rc = c['conversions'].sum() / c['visitors'].sum()
rt = t['conversions'].sum() / t['visitors'].sum()
result = round((rt - rc) * 100, 2)

title: Pooled z-test p-value
task: Set result to the two-sided p-value of the pooled two-proportion z-test (treatment vs control, overall totals), rounded to 5 decimals.
answer:
c = ab_daily[ab_daily['variant'] == 'control']
t = ab_daily[ab_daily['variant'] == 'treatment']
xc, nc = c['conversions'].sum(), c['visitors'].sum()
xt, nt = t['conversions'].sum(), t['visitors'].sum()
pp = (xc + xt) / (nc + nt)
se = np.sqrt(pp * (1 - pp) * (1 / nc + 1 / nt))
z = (xt / nt - xc / nc) / se
result = round(float(2 * (1 - stats.norm.cdf(abs(z)))), 5)

title: A/B margin of error
task: Set result to the 95% margin of error for the overall treatment conversion proportion = 1.96*sqrt(p(1-p)/n), rounded to 4 decimals.
answer:
t = ab_daily[ab_daily['variant'] == 'treatment']
p = t['conversions'].sum() / t['visitors'].sum()
n = t['visitors'].sum()
result = round(1.96 * np.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n), 4)

title: Grand mean vs arm means

answer:

result = round(float(m.var()), 3)

title: Eta-squared
task: Set result to eta-squared for arm on score, rounded to 4 decimals.
hint: SS_between via group means; SS_total via overall mean.
answer:
gm = trials['score'].mean()
ss_total = ((trials['score'] - gm) ** 2).sum()
ss_between = sum(len(g) * (g.mean() - gm) ** 2 for _, g in trials.groupby('arm')['score'])
result = round(float(ss_between / ss_total), 4)

title: Best day for treatment
task: Set result to the date (str) with the highest treatment conversion rate.
answer:

t['rate'] = t['conversions'] / t['visitors']
result = t.loc[t['rate'].idxmax(), 'date']
